name: Mapillary provider/city-disjoint first-OCR transfer of the fixed distinctive-token branch
question: Does the fixed distinctive-token branch recover at least the two Mapillary targets whose earlier human audit reported visible name credentials, while emitting no wrong target in a seventeen-target roster?

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

name_token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens

distinctive_edit_token_contract.apostrophe_or_token_fragment_rule: For a row with two or three normalized tokens, also test their concatenation; this converts p + tits to ptits without changing OCR text.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.evidence_weighting: Each distinct matched target token of length 6-7 contributes one unit; length >=8 contributes two units. A target matches at two units.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.uniqueness_rule: Emit a lexical search-priority candidate only when exactly one target in the frozen seventeen-target roster matches.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.association: Exact or Levenshtein-distance-one normalized token evidence only within one human-window-conditioned Mapillary observation.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.authority: Search-priority candidate only; no token, sign, facade, entity, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, or safety authority.

execution_rule: Run once. Preserve UNKNOWN on Oude Kerk or PKN Kievitkerk if the frozen minimum token length or observation reachability does not authorize a match; do not tune after result.

claim_boundary.allowed: Provider- and city-disjoint Development evidence about first-OCR transfer of the fixed distinctive-token referent-candidate branch on four previously human-reviewed, human-window-conditioned Mapillary images.
not_allowed: pixel-unseen, active-sequence, automatic entrance-ray, independent portal, full combined-router, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, deployment, or safety confirmation
OCR evidence proving exact entity identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, or portal ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, or user benefit
